targets.queryText: SELECT c.scenario_id AS 'Scenario', c.edge_threshold AS 'Edge Threshold', CASE WHEN c.is_primary = 1 THEN 'PRIMARY' ELSE '' END AS 'Role', COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.simulated_flat = 1 THEN t.simulated_net_pnl ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 'Simulated Net P&L', COUNT(CASE WHEN t.simulated_flat = 1 THEN 1 END) AS 'Closed Trades', COUNT(CASE WHEN t.simulated_flat = 0 THEN 1 END) AS 'Open Positions', c.execution_timing_basis AS 'Timing Basis' FROM scenario_catalog c LEFT JOIN trades t ON t.scenario_id = c.scenario_id AND (t.run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} OR ${run_id:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${run_id:sqlstring} = '__current__' AND t.run_id = (SELECT value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key='input_run_id'))) GROUP BY c.scenario_id ORDER BY c.edge_threshold
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT c.scenario_id AS 'Scenario', c.edge_threshold AS 'Edge Threshold', CASE WHEN c.is_primary = 1 THEN 'PRIMARY' ELSE '' END AS 'Role', COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN t.simulated_flat = 1 THEN t.simulated_net_pnl ELSE 0 END), 0) AS 'Simulated Net P&L', COUNT(CASE WHEN t.simulated_flat = 1 THEN 1 END) AS 'Closed Trades', COUNT(CASE WHEN t.simulated_flat = 0 THEN 1 END) AS 'Open Positions', c.execution_timing_basis AS 'Timing Basis' FROM scenario_catalog c LEFT JOIN trades t ON t.scenario_id = c.scenario_id AND (t.run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} OR ${run_id:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${run_id:sqlstring} = '__current__' AND t.run_id = (SELECT value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key='input_run_id'))) GROUP BY c.scenario_id ORDER BY c.edge_threshold

targets.queryText: SELECT t.run_id AS 'Run', t.scenario_id AS 'Scenario', t.market_ticker AS 'Market', t.position_id AS 'Position', t.entry_utc AS 'Entry UTC', t.exit_utc AS 'Exit UTC', t.entry_simulated_quantity AS 'Entry Qty', t.net_simulated_position_quantity AS 'Open Qty', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.simulated_quantity * e.simulated_price + e.simulated_fee) FROM shadow_events e WHERE e.run_id = t.run_id AND e.scenario_id = t.scenario_id AND e.position_id = t.position_id AND e.event_type = 'shadow_simulated_fill' AND e.side = 'buy'), 0) AS 'Simulated Entry Outlay', t.simulated_net_pnl AS 'Simulated P&L', t.simulated_flat AS 'Flat' FROM trades t WHERE t.run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} OR ${run_id:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${run_id:sqlstring} = '__current__' AND t.run_id = (SELECT value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key='input_run_id')) ORDER BY COALESCE(t.exit_utc, t.entry_utc) DESC LIMIT 100
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT t.run_id AS 'Run', t.scenario_id AS 'Scenario', t.market_ticker AS 'Market', t.position_id AS 'Position', t.entry_utc AS 'Entry UTC', t.exit_utc AS 'Exit UTC', t.entry_simulated_quantity AS 'Entry Qty', t.net_simulated_position_quantity AS 'Open Qty', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.simulated_quantity * e.simulated_price + e.simulated_fee) FROM shadow_events e WHERE e.run_id = t.run_id AND e.scenario_id = t.scenario_id AND e.position_id = t.position_id AND e.event_type = 'shadow_simulated_fill' AND e.side = 'buy'), 0) AS 'Simulated Entry Outlay', t.simulated_net_pnl AS 'Simulated P&L', t.simulated_flat AS 'Flat' FROM trades t WHERE t.run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} OR ${run_id:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${run_id:sqlstring} = '__current__' AND t.run_id = (SELECT value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key='input_run_id')) ORDER BY COALESCE(t.exit_utc, t.entry_utc) DESC LIMIT 100

targets.queryText: SELECT scenario_id AS 'Scenario', COALESCE(reason, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS 'No-Fill Reason', COUNT(*) AS 'Count' FROM shadow_events WHERE event_type = 'shadow_no_fill' AND (run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} OR ${run_id:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${run_id:sqlstring} = '__current__' AND run_id = (SELECT value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key='input_run_id'))) GROUP BY scenario_id, reason ORDER BY Count DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT scenario_id AS 'Scenario', COALESCE(reason, 'UNSPECIFIED') AS 'No-Fill Reason', COUNT(*) AS 'Count' FROM shadow_events WHERE event_type = 'shadow_no_fill' AND (run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} OR ${run_id:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${run_id:sqlstring} = '__current__' AND run_id = (SELECT value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key='input_run_id'))) GROUP BY scenario_id, reason ORDER BY Count DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', exit_utc) AS INTEGER) AS time, scenario_id AS metric, SUM(simulated_net_pnl) OVER (PARTITION BY scenario_id ORDER BY exit_utc, position_id) AS value FROM trades WHERE simulated_flat = 1 AND exit_utc IS NOT NULL AND (run_id = ${run_id:sqlstring} OR ${run_id:sqlstring} = '__all__' OR (${run_id:sqlstring} = '__current__' AND run_id = (SELECT value FROM dashboard_metadata WHERE key='input_run_id'))) ORDER BY exit_utc, scenario_id, position_id
